| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vendor/mathlive/` | MathLive (Arno Gourdol and contributors), https://github.com/arnog/mathlive | 0.111.4 | MIT (`LICENSE.txt`) |
| `vendor/compute-engine/` | CortexJS Compute Engine, https://github.com/cortex-js/compute-engine | 0.185.1 (only the files the tool loads, including `compile.js` for graphs) | MIT (`LICENSE`) |
| `vendor/mathjax/` | MathJax, https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax | 3.2.2 (`tex-svg.js`) | Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`), unmodified |
| `vendor/function-plot/` | function-plot (Mauricio Poppe), https://github.com/mauriciopoppe/function-plot | 1.26.0 | MIT (`LICENSE`) |
